resources.string: Remove all music managed by MetroList and disconnect the selected Car Library. Files inside the external Car Library folder are left untouched.

This removes %1$d downloaded/imported track(s), clears MetroList audio caches, and disconnects the Car Library containing %2$d track(s). External Car Library files are not deleted. This cannot be undone for local app-managed files.
Removed %1$d local track(s). The Car Library was disconnected and its external files were kept.
